text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while after that,
training progressed entirely according to
the methods Sirius Symboli laid out
herself.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. That's a wrap for today.
Good work. You're free to head back too.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —What is it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The training regimens she devises are always
impeccable.
Without any advice that could surpass hers,
I hesitate to even speak up.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I silently watch Sirius Symboli walk away.
In the end,
since the day we signed our contract,
we haven't had a single proper
discussion...
choice_data_list: (Can things really go on like this...
(Can things really go on like this...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli's training is progressing
smoothly,
and there's no room for me to interject.
Perhaps it's best not to interfere—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I broke the chains.
Whether you bare your fangs or tuck your
tail and run—
the rest is your choice to make.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The moment her words from that day crossed
my mind...
before my thoughts could even take shape,
my legs started moving on their own.

text_block_list.name: Rowdy Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Who're you?
That badge... wait, are you a Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mischievous Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Huh? Hey, aren't you... Sirius-senpai's—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Well, well... What an unexpected guest.
What do you want?
Don't tell me you're looking to play with
fire?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Talk, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Don't make me laugh.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Did you really think a leashed pet
could bite its master so easily?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Fine by me.
If you're finally developing a sense of
self...
it's the perfect chance to put you in your
place.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You said you wanted to talk to me, right?
Then...
you'll have to earn your right to sit at my
table.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—That's right,
a match.
The loser obeys whatever the winner says.
Simple enough rules, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Nine-ball...
Pocket balls one through nine in order,
and whoever sinks the nine-ball wins.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Normally,
hitting them out of order is a foul...
but as a handicap,
I'll allow you up to three fouls.
You can shoot in whatever order you like. Easy,
right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Go on, I'll even let you break.
...Naturally, you're not going to refuse,
are you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Swept up in Sirius Symboli's momentum,
I accepted the match...
I didn't want to make her obey me...
I just wanted to have an open
conversation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, this is a chance. If I win,
it could open the door to a real dialogue.
With the handicap,
I should have a fighting chance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Clack, clatter, roll...*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However—things don't go smoothly at all.
With each miss, my palms grow sweatier,
making my grip on the cue slip even more.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Another miss, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...I don't mind roasting on low heat,
but there's no point if the fire goes out
cold.
—Watch closely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—In that instant.
Just like during her races,
an explosive aura of fighting spirit surged
forth—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The balls scattered in all directions,
sinking into pockets one after another,
until the final nine-ball dropped cleanly
in—!
choice_data_list: (Wait, in the blink of an eye...?!)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
And that puts an end to your little
rebellion.
The dynamic between master and servant is
crystal clear—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, you obey me.
...You'd better engrave that into your
memory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now our dynamic has been set in stone.
If only I hadn't let myself be dragged into
the match from the start and had properly
asserted that I just wanted to talk...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh, wipe that pathetic look off your face,
will you? Come on,
pack your things.
A master needs to walk their dog once in a
while...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether on a whim or simply amused by my
dejected reaction...
Sirius Symboli accompanied me on the walk
back to the academy. When suddenly—

—Allow me to offer an objective
assessment.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
!
That's...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Catching the sound of a familiar voice,
I turned around to see Symboli Rudolf talking
to a student. Come to think of it—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both hail from the Symboli family,
and with both of their parents involved with
the URA,
I've heard they've crossed paths often since
they were young.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
From what I can observe,
the training regimen you are currently
undergoing carries an excessively high
workload.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If you continue down this path,
injury will be inevitable.
Surely your legs have made that painfully
clear to you already, haven't they?

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior
text_block_list.text:
I know that...
but still—I've made up my mind!
Now that I've reached my prime,
I want to do everything I possibly
can...!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
While your determination is commendable,
as Student Council President, I cannot—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Hey.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...She's my junior.
Don't go filling her head with your useless
nonsense.
